cuts.ofreeRecent: a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; a bridal room — holds a small bouquet in both hands at her waist; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; a present-day seaside arcade with a glass prize-claw machine filled with folded plush stars — using the claw-machine joystick with a sharpshooter’s patience; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; an indoor climbing wall of coloured holds — kneeling on the ground; a far-future orbital hotel recreation pool under a transparent observation dome — trying the low-gravity relaxation deck after a swim; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — holds an ice cream cone at chest height; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — standing with one foot up on a step
